commands.counted_by: sed -n '/^## Reference of every command and option/,$p' COMMANDS.md | grep -c '^### `awb '

lines_awb.counted_by: git ls-files -z -- 'awb/*.py' | xargs -0 cat | wc -l (lines of the tracked Python files of awb/, comments and blanks included)

test_functions.counted_by: git grep -hE '^[[:space:]]*(async[[:space:]]+)?def test_' -- 'tests/*.py' | wc -l (a def, a parametrized test counts once)
